scientific_integrity: Analytic proof establishes all-dimensional statements; finite numerical checks are corroborative. Historical priority remains provisional and independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Classification applies only to a fixed full-dimensional axis-aligned orthotope translated in one coordinate under standard isotropic Gaussian surface density; no simultaneous multidirectional translation or non-Gaussian classification is claimed. The noncentral maximizer solves a transcendental equation.
title: Sharp Gaussian-perimeter symmetry breaking for one-axis translations of orthotopes
